verdict.rationale: Tilled provides payouts view, batch closing for reconciliation, and webhooks for event notifications, which touch on ledger-adjacent functionality, but there is no evidence of a unified ledger showing fee-account balances, split tracking from charge through payout, or penny-level reconciliation reporting. missing for 10: consolidated ledger/balance view across seller and platform fee accounts, explicit charge-to-split-to-payout traceability, reconciliation reports or statements, evidence of penny-accurate accounting tools.
